title: Rampart coverage ledger
description: projects/<slug>/coverage.json: which units (repo directories, host probes) each run covered, and with which pack versions. Keys of `units` are <system>|<layer>|<unitId>; every value must match $defs.unitEntry (the store checks each entry, because the validator has no per-key schema).

classes.description: Optional: the pack class ids hunted on this unit at these pack versions (added by Plan 2's fix wave; an entry without it records no classes).

effort.description: Optional: the effort of the run that stamped this entry.
